fichas.title: Building Development Proposal: Site and House Location
fichas.summary: The building development proposal considers the location of the house on its plot. The diagrams show site access, roads, setback areas, building placement, garden areas, and subsidiary rooms; a residential floor plan illustrates development of the design from the proposal.
uses: Assessing house location on a plot
Developing a building proposal into a house design

fichas.title: Architectural Services: Work Phases
fichas.summary: The page describes architectural services and fees, noting that national and professional guidelines such as Germany’s HOAI broadly follow a structure comparable to the RIBA Architects’ Plan of Work. It outlines basic and special services for collection of basic information, preliminary design, and design. Services include clarifying tasks and aims, preparing design alternatives and drawings, coordinating specialist input, consulting authorities, estimating and controlling costs, and considering optimisation. The text also mentions special services for credit, building permission, technical diagrams, scheduling, environmental analysis, and building optimisation.
uses: Preparing preliminary designs and design alternatives
Developing and documenting a building design
Coordinating specialist engineers and other experts
